intro.title: Hart County Magistrate Court
intro.description: Magistrate Court handles a variety of civil and criminal matters for Hart County, including claims, dispossessory cases, warrants, hearings, ordinance violations, and other matters within the court's jurisdiction.

contact.location: Hart County Courthouse on the square in downtown Hartwell

resources.title: Online Filing – Statement of Claims or Dispossessory Cases

criminal_matters: Judges are on call 24 hours a day for criminal matters.
Magistrate judges issue misdemeanor and felony warrants and conduct first appearance hearings, pre-warrant hearings, and bond hearings.
Other criminal matters include county ordinance violations, bad checks, and special misdemeanor charges.
civil_matters: The defendant or business must be located in Hart County.
The filer must provide the Court with the correct street address for proper service.
fee_notice: Effective July 1, 2024, all filing fees increased by $4.00.

filing_fees.name: Statement of Claim
filing_fees.detail: $108.00 for one defendant; add $50.00 for each additional defendant.

filing_fees.name: Foreclosure
filing_fees.detail: $108.00. If filing for a vehicle, you must bring the title with you.

filing_fees.name: Interrogatory
filing_fees.detail: $10.00 plus a $50.00 service fee, for a $60.00 total.
